segments.text:
We will explore
General Schematic Preferences
within the Altium Designer environment.

Ensure the top-level schematic sheet
is open and visible

as the active document
in the design space.

Observe how the wires are currently
displayed to the left of the component U2.

We can adjust how Altium displays
wire cross-overs
from within the Preferences.

Select the Preferences icon
near the upper right
to open the Preferences window.

Expand the Schematic branch
and select General.

Enable Display Cross-Overs,
as shown.

Hit Apply to see the changes applied
within the schematic.
Alternatively,

simply click OK to close
the Preferences window
and apply the new settings.

Let's explore
another preference option.

In this case,
the Components Cut Wires setting.
Let's go back into the Preferences
by selecting the Preferences icon.
Go into Schematic,
then General.

Verify that Components Cut Wires
is enabled.
To show this functionality,
R11 will be copied.
Pasting the copied resistor,

and placing it directly on
an existing wire.

We can see that the component
cut the wire

and was placed in-line
within this signal path.
There's no need to delete the wire

and redraw it
around the new resistor.

Now you now how to set
General Schematic Preferences
in Altium Designer.

title: Altium Training - Schematic Preferences: General Preferences
